best_window: Early morning to late morning before wind builds
report_text:
The model expects 10-14 ft of visibility, resulting in a C grade. Conditions are moderately favorable overall, but the algorithm is seeing enough surface movement to prevent a clearer B-grade forecast.

The tide contribution is more neutral because a reliable direction is not available. The next low tide at 7:15 PM could still change nearshore water movement, so local clarity may vary.

Overall, the forecast remains diveable, but clarity may vary by location and could be worse around shallow reefs, sandy bottoms and areas exposed to surge.
